result.description: AI-powered academic search engine that finds, ranks and synthesizes peer-reviewed research with cited answers.
result.auth_detail: REST API: API key (docs conflict on header: Authorization Bearer vs x-api-key). OAuth 2.1 (auth code + PKCE, DCR) only for the MCP server, not documented for REST. Anonymous rate-limited MCP tier also exists.
result.access_detail: API keys issued from org subscription page; API included on every paid plan (Pro, Deep, Teams, Enterprise). Free plan API access unverified. Per-plan quotas live on docs.consensus.app, which returned 403 to automated fetch. Enterprise via contact sales.
result.api_notes: Base https://api.consensus.app (from a curl example). Known: GET /v1/search (paper search), POST /v1/threads (async research agent, deep mode). llms-full.txt mentions paper detail, synthesis and Consensus Meter endpoints with no paths. OpenAPI at docs.consensus.app/openapi.json not fetched. Docs host blocked, so the endpoint list is unverified.
result.blocker: REST API needs a paid plan for the API key, so end users need paid orgs. The only OAuth is on the MCP server (DCR; Composio-managed OAuth reportedly unavailable). The API surface is narrow and docs were not fully verifiable (header format conflict, docs 403).

evidence.quote: Consensus is an AI-powered scientific search engine that finds, ranks, and synthesizes peer-reviewed research
Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every request
First-class MCP server with OAuth 2.1 and dynamic client registration, plus a REST API.
Issued from the organization subscription page at https://consensus.app/subscription/api/
Included on every paid plan, and Deep includes 5x the usage of Pro.
Bring up-to-date, peer-reviewed citations into your workflows.
